title: Localized LoRA-MoE: Mixture of Low-Rank Experts With Adaptive Routing
abstract: arXiv:2607.05114v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods such as LoRA adapt large models through a single low-rank update. Such updates are susceptible to gradient interference: when a training stream interleaves multiple operational contexts, conflicting updates to shared adapter weights collapse the adapter into an unspecialized average. While recent methods introduce block-wise isolation to remedy this issue, their topologies are static and cannot adapt to context switching or localized sensor degradation. In this work, we introduce Localized LoRA-MoE, a framework that combines localized spatial blocking with context-conditioned expert routing. translated_title: 局部化LoRA-MoE：具有自适应路由的低秩专家混合
translated_abstract: 参数高效微调（PEFT）方法（如LoRA）通过单一低秩更新来适配大型模型。这类更新容易受到梯度干扰的影响：当训练流中交织着多个操作上下文时，对共享适配器权重的相互冲突的更新会使适配器坍缩成一个缺乏专门化的平均值。虽然近期的方法引入了块级隔离来缓解这一问题，但其拓扑结构是静态的，无法适应上下文切换或局部传感器退化。在这项工作中，我们提出了Localized LoRA-MoE，一个将局部空间分块与上下文条件专家路由相结合的框架。我们提出并评估了两种架构变体：Block-Wise LoRA-MoE（集中式路由），它通过单一的上下文条件门控来调制整个结构网格；以及Cell-Wise LoRA-MoE（去中心化路由），它为结构网格的每个坐标单元分配一个独立的门控。
tldr: 提出Localized LoRA-MoE框架，将局部空间分块与上下文条件自适应专家路由相结合，提供了集中式块级路由和去中心化单元级路由两种架构变体，以解决传统PEFT方法中的梯度干扰和静态拓扑无法适应上下文切换的问题。
en_tdlr: Localized LoRA-MoE combines localized spatial blocking with context-conditioned adaptive expert routing, offering both centralized block-wise and decentralized cell-wise routing variants to overcome gradient interference and the static topology limitations of conventional PEFT methods.
